description: For a product, a quantity and a country: the price tiers by quantity, what their quantity costs (pieces and order fees, without shipping), the minimum, the variants, the weight and size declared by the seller, and the type of line — sample (1 to 3 pieces, fast line, duties paid) or batch (delivery paid at weighing, by a second payment). Rabbit gives no shipping amount. Use when they talk about a batch or ask which way to go. Counts one product page against their daily limit.

pays.description: The delivery country, as a two-letter code (FR, US, DE…); their account’s if omitted.

produit.description: The `produit` reference returned by a search (starts with “p”).

quantite.description: The number of pieces the client said.
